scripts.//build:tools: Bundles dist/migrate.mjs, the image's migrate job (no Prisma CLI in the image).
scripts.//test:integration: Postgres integration tests. Needs TEST_DATABASE_URL: a dedicated, migrated database whose license tables are emptied. Skipped without it.
scripts.//check:migrations: Applies every migration to the empty DATABASE_URL database and fails if the result differs from prisma/schema.prisma (a schema change without a migration).
scripts.check:migrations: prisma migrate deploy && prisma migrate diff --from-config-datasource --to-schema prisma/schema.prisma --exit-code
scripts.//check:chart: Lints and renders chart/ with helm and checks the manifests. Applies nothing.
